app.title: Epsilon AI Reviewer
home.title: New analysis
home.description: Analyse a game record with AI to review every player's decisions.
home.urlPlaceholder: Paste a Tenhou game record URL
model.label: Analysis model
model.hint: Choose a model available on the server.
history.title: Analysis history
history.searchPlaceholder: Player name, record type or model
history.searchHint: Try a different player name, record type or model.
history.deleteDescription: This deletes the saved analysis, its copy of the game record and the history entry. Your original file and the record at its source are not affected.
confirm.title: Confirm analysis
confirm.allPlayers: All four players are analysed. You can switch perspectives during the replay.
confirm.saved: Completed analyses are saved and can be opened from your history.
progress.label: Analysis progress
progress.running: Calculating AI action probabilities for all four players
progress.reconnectHint: Refresh to try loading the analysis status or result again.
storage.title: What gets saved
storage.gameDescription: Player names, final scores, number of hands, record type, a copy of the original game record and replay data.
storage.analysisDescription: Candidate actions and AI probabilities for all four players, the model name and version, and the analysis date and time.
storage.desktop: Analysis results are saved as files on this computer and can be opened from your history. You can choose a different folder for new results in settings.
storage.desktopTransfer: The game record or its URL is sent to the connected server for analysis.
storage.web: Game records, replay data, analysis results and history are saved on the server. A browser cookie stores only the key used to access your history.
storage.cookie: If you delete this cookie, you will lose access to your history in this browser. The saved data remains on the server.
storage.delete: Choose “Delete analysis” in a history entry to delete the saved analysis, its copy of the game record and the entry.
settings.title: Server and storage settings
replay.title: Game review
replay.agreementDescription: The percentage of decisions matching the highest AI probability after combining hand discards and tsumogiri of the same tile. Tied top choices count as matches.
replay.badMoveDescription: The percentage of decisions with an AI probability below 5% that did not match a top choice, after combining hand discards and tsumogiri of the same tile.
candidate.heading: AI probabilities

share.title: Share link
share.description: Anyone with this link can view the player names, all players' hands and the AI analysis.
share.copyManually: The link is selected. Copy it manually.
share.deleteHint: The share link will stop working if you delete this analysis.
storage.sharing: The web app automatically creates a share link for each analysis. Anyone with the link can view player names, all players' hands and the AI analysis. Deleting the analysis also disables its link.
errors.share_not_found: This link is invalid or its analysis is no longer available. Check the link with the person who shared it.
errors.share_unavailable: This analysis cannot be shared. Only analyses created in the web app can be shared.
